subject: Discovery recap — Greyline use case & suggested next step
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Mitchell <lauren@greyline.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — Greyline use case & suggested next step

Hi Lauren — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discussion and a proposed next step.

Summary of your priorities
- Lower per-token inference cost for ranked search re-runs (batch reranking of 50–200 queries/day).
- Keep 95th percentile latency under 250ms for live preview.
- Maintain data isolation for PII-sensitive logs.

What we heard from you
- Primary model use is re-ranking + short-form summarization for 3 product teams.
- Timeline: pilot with one product team in Q4; cross-team rollout in H1.
- Procurement will want a short commercial summary and SOC2 evidence.

Proposed next step
1) Run a 2-week pilot on a small dataset (we'll provide a trial pool with dedicated capacity)
2) Measurement plan: latency p95, cost/token, example-quality checks against your eval set
3) Quick procurement packet (SLA, SOC2 summary, data retention) for your legal/procurement review

Attachments: discovery deck and a short pilot outline are attached for your review.

If that plan sounds reasonable, can we lock a 30-min kickoff next week (Tue/Wed preferred)? I can send a calendar link.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Reengage: Greyline pilot ROI estimate & quick ask for fit feedback

Hi Lauren — I know teams get busy, so I wanted to share a concrete, short ROI snapshot that might help internal prioritization and ask a small favor.

Quick ROI snapshot (pilot signal)
- Based on the usage profile you shared (50–200 reranks/day): estimated pilot cost on Redwood Dedicated trial pool ~ $1,400 over 2 weeks (with caching and batching applied).
- Expected production run-rate (if expanded) could be ~ $2,800–$3,600/month depending on batching and KV cache hit rate — we can tighten after seeing real traces.
- Latency: with our default config we expect p95 ~160–220ms on T4xlarge-style nodes (your 250ms goal is achievable with modest autoscale headroom).

Small ask: can you reply with one-line feedback on fit so I can triage next actions? Options that are helpful: 
- "Pilot — ready to kickoff"
- "Interest — need procurement/SOC2 details first"
- "Not a fit right now"

If you prefer, I can also send a one-page procurement packet and a calendar link for a 30-min kickoff. No pressure — if timing isn't right, a one-line update helps us re-prioritize.

Thanks for any quick feedback. If easier, feel free to loop in your procurement contact and I can follow directly.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
